notes: Driven with Playwright at 390 (touch) and 1280, Haeun toggle, 14 and 34 customers. Web fonts were blocked, so fallback fonts rendered; widths may differ slightly. A-D share one picker that lists only pinned, recent and covered customers; non-covered customers need typing or a list screen. A-D have no unsaved-edit guard; in A a pin click replaced a dirty Orders API edit with Mirae Pay's editor. E variants share lists, panel and guards; they differ only in the picker. In every candidate the who-gets-called view is a live editor. Haeun defaults to All customers everywhere.
